title: Add missing values and Agent Setup to an existing binding

rubric.text: The response starts from the existing binding, adds alice as execution approver and Agent Setup, and preserves verified Project IDs, Status, labels, merge policy, and trusted reference

Without agent preferences, the response proposes a configured default-owner runtime-default profile for planner and ticket plus the available read-only-evidence helper, not TypeSafe or invented model choices
The response reports ready-to-commit after validation without migrating Ready items, changing Project state, rebuilding the binding, or committing implicitly
